title: Choose what a story's review compares in Intent

intentCoverage.report:
Dough Intent Coverage: one break check

Verdict: Caught.

Story and revision: .planning/seeds/SEED-420-unified-intent-review.md#choose-story-comparison-in-intent (plan 760, slices 5 and 6), checked at 92970283805faa610e3a824898c28996851fe0fc in an isolated scratch worktree (detached, clean before the probe, npm ci on Node 24.21.0 per .node-version), since removed and pruned.

Promise checked: CI comparison and Intent coverage keep describing the whole story through the default comparison, and while another comparison is chosen each says so (naming the measured build when known). This holds even when the chosen comparison cannot be read (state "unreadable").

Fault: dashboard/src/IntentStoryComparison.tsx, otherThanDefaultChosen
  - compareOf(comparison)?.isDefault === false;
  + comparison.state === "compared" && comparison.compare?.isDefault === false;
so only a readable chosen comparison counts as "other than default". It feeds wholeStoryOf (IntentStorySummary.tsx), which IntentPage.tsx and useIntentStoryLens.ts both use. No fixtures or assertions were changed.

Command (scratch root): caffeinate -s -i env -u GIT_ALTERNATE_OBJECT_DIRECTORIES -u NO_COLOR -u FORCE_COLOR OPEN_DOUGH_DASHBOARD_FRONTEND_PROOF_RECORD=<job tmp json> node scripts/test-frontend.mjs dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-story-compare-gaps.spec.ts dashboard/frontend-tests/intent/intent-story-compare-evidence.spec.ts

Results (proof-record JSON):
  - Baseline: selectedCount 6, strictStatus passed, runner 11.4 s.
  - Faulted: selectedCount 6, strictStatus failed, runner 12.8 s. Two tests failed:
    * intent-story-compare-gaps.spec.ts:56 "an unavailable commit range is explained in the header...", step "CI comparison and Intent coverage say they describe the whole story" (line 78): the line-81 assertion on the CI comparison whole-story note failed with "element(s) not found".
    * intent-story-compare-gaps.spec.ts:155 "a Done story's landed run whose objects are missing is explained...", step "CI comparison and Intent coverage say they describe the whole story at the measured build" (line 179): the line-183 check on the CI comparison note failed with "element(s) not found"; the build-naming check was not reached.
    * The other 4 tests passed (2 evidence-spec tests on the readable path, 2 Retry tests).
  - Restored: git diff empty at HEAD 929702838; selectedCount 6, strictStatus passed, runner 7.7 s.

Reach: the earlier step in each failing test passed, so the header showed "The chosen changes could not be read." and the unreadable state was reached. The faulted snapshot shows tabpanel "CI comparison" with only the "CI status of Story A" region and no whole-story note. The catch is limited to the CI comparison panel; Intent coverage and the build-naming part read the same wholeStoryOf value and were not separately observed under this fault.

Next proof action: none needed for this fault; the maintained gaps-spec assertions catch it on the unreadable Taken-range and Done-landed-run paths. Optionally probe the IntentPage-only fault; this report does not judge it.

Cost: test runtime 32.0 s (baseline 11.4 + faulted 12.8 + restored 7.7), excluding npm ci and worktree setup. Human and agent effort unavailable. Invocation-to-report elapsed 95909 ms (measured).

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 92970283805faa610e3a824898c28996851fe0fc, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
